name: B3·2 Money Engine — payment links + polite chasing + scheme instalment reminders (3 automations combined)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ SETUP — step by step
1. **Razorpay:** dashboard.razorpay.com → Settings → API Keys → key_id + key_secret. In n8n add credential 'Basic Auth' (user = key_id, password = key_secret) on both Razorpay nodes.
2. Tabs needed: **Dues** (Customer, Phone, Amount, Purpose, LinkSent, PaidStatus) and **SchemeMembers** (Name, Phone, Monthly, DayOfMonth, LastPaidMonth).
3. Variables: TG_OWNER_CHAT_ID, BRAND_NAME. Attach Telegram + Sheets credentials. Replace REPLACE_SHEET_ID.

## HOW IT RUNS
• Daily 10:30 — any Dues row without LinkSent → creates a real Razorpay payment link → wa.me message with the link ready to send → marks LinkSent.
• Daily 10:35 — unpaid links older than 3 days → polite chase message drafted to your Telegram.
• Daily 09:45 — SchemeMembers whose DayOfMonth = today & LastPaidMonth ≠ this month → instalment reminder (wa.me) to your Telegram to fire.

## 🔧 FIX
• 401 from Razorpay → wrong key/secret or test-vs-live mismatch.
• Duplicate links → LinkSent column not updating (check sheet permissions).
• Compliance note: keep scheme reminders as service messages; marketing content needs opt-in.
